name: Net2u
summary: National dialup ISP (~2001); defunct (ACCSYS IT PTY LTD, ACN 097 124 297).

events.details: Defunct. Net2U's retail ISP homepage survived to Feb 2012 and was replaced by the AccsysIT corporate site by Apr 2013, as proposed. became AccsysIT.

refs.label: 21 Feb 2012 still the Net2U retail ISP portal
By 10 Apr 2013 the domain carried AccsysIT's IT-services site; Net2U reduced to a hosting side-link
